source: Pacheco et al. 2019, PeerJ 7: e7963, Fig. 8: multi-panel figure: (A) strict consensus of early dinosaurs and relatives, a vertical tree with the root at the bottom, rotated tip labels, coloured clade blocks with silhouettes and Bremer values; (B) a bivariate morphospace plot and (C) a time-scaled panel with silhouettes.
